title: Version 1.51.0
html:
Version 1.51.0

March 1st, 2024

Added:

  • Introducing the River: an entirely new area to explore! You can access it from the logic area, desert area, or toxic area. Be sure to bring a few explosives!
  • A new store to find... however, it takes a weird form of currency!
  • New wacky items, one might give you food poisoning, the other.. is a mystery
  • Added the sticky bomb, don't accidentally get it stuck on your hand!
  • New equipment system as well as three new equipable items: the Rusty Scooba Tank, the Refined Scooba Tank (NO, IT'S NOT A TYPO, MOM), and Night Vision Goggles
  • New pickaxe :)
  • New Lumite ore
  • Three new opal ore variants: Magma Opal, Tide Opal, and Crystal Opal
  • A counterpart to kelp... PLEK!
  • Added a bunch of in-game easter eggs, have fun figuring out what they are :)

Changes:

  • The caves now have a new ambience, this should make things look more pleasing
  • The Emberbane and Festive Axe now have better icons that are more accurate
  • Achievements now show their current state regardless if you completed it
  • The shoplifter achievement now functions differently, it is cumulative rather than a single purchase
  • Oxygen, health, and money now show when you are driving
  • Redesigned meteor core models by jadeiya
  • Disabled water movement animation due to performance

Fixes:

  • Some weird issues with vehicle welding should be fixed
  • Signs can now have their color again
  • A bunch of random errors have been fixed, hopefully this will magically resolve things
  • Really long wires can now be interacted with if you are near the center of the wire
  • The Angled Corner Cylinder Wedge (this is the internal name) now works with the Architect gamepass
  • The Lumberjack achievement should now work again, this broke with the tree revamp
  • Fixed the scientist girl having santa's dialogue.. she's just obsessed, okay? No need to judge
  • Some missing wire translation strings are now correct
  • Some trees (such as cactus) should now save on your property
  • Water should no longer start randomly killing you (this was a weird one)
  • The handles on crates should now not have any collision
  • The switch on the alignment conveyor should work now, allowing you to reverse it and fully stop it
  • Console users can now use creative wiring correctly on string lights, etc. Sorry!!

Version 1.51.1

March 3rd, 2024

Changes:

  • Map Fixes
  • Nerfed Plek

Fixes:

  • Fixed vehicle TP method
  • Fixed mysterious mushroom cave having an orange roof
  • Fixed mysterious mushroom's chop requirements
